scripts.local: [ -d data/otomads/tools ] || { echo "音MAD 数据 submodule 未初始化：git submodule update --init data/otomads"; exit 1; }; cd data/otomads/tools && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv/cache uv run python -m otomads.local_source --config ../../../local-source.toml
scripts.data:build: cd tools && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv/cache uv run python -m tmc.build
scripts.data:check: cd tools && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv/cache uv run python -m tmc.build --check
scripts.data:validate: cd tools && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv/cache uv run python -m tmc.validate --report
scripts.data:roster: cd tools && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv/cache uv run python -m tmc.roster
scripts.data:scaffold: cd tools && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv/cache uv run python -m tmc.scaffold
scripts.audio:fetch: [ -d data/otomads/tools ] || { echo "音MAD 数据 submodule 未初始化：git submodule update --init data/otomads"; exit 1; }; cd data/otomads/tools && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv/cache uv run python -m otomads.fetch_audio --config ../../../local-source.toml
scripts.audio:measure: [ -d data/otomads/tools ] || { echo "音MAD 数据 submodule 未初始化：git submodule update --init data/otomads"; exit 1; }; cd data/otomads/tools && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv/cache uv run python -m otomads.measure_loudness
scripts.media:pack: [ -d data/otomads/tools ] || { echo "音MAD 数据 submodule 未初始化：git submodule update --init data/otomads"; exit 1; }; cd data/otomads/tools && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv/cache uv run python -m otomads.stage_media pack --library ../../../.music --cards ../../../public/cards-otomads --out ../../../otomads-media.tar.gz
scripts.media:stage: [ -d data/otomads/tools ] || { echo "音MAD 数据 submodule 未初始化：git submodule update --init data/otomads"; exit 1; }; cd data/otomads/tools && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv/cache uv run python -m otomads.stage_media stage --from ../../../.music --cards ../../../public/cards-otomads --out ../../../dist
scripts.media:pull: [ -d data/otomads/tools ] || { echo "音MAD 数据 submodule 未初始化：git submodule update --init data/otomads"; exit 1; }; [ -n "$OTOMADS_MEDIA_URL" ] || { echo "用法：OTOMADS_MEDIA_URL=<归档 URL 或路径> pnpm media:pull"; exit 1; }; cd data/otomads/tools && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv/cache uv run python -m otomads.stage_media stage --archive "$OTOMADS_MEDIA_URL" --out ../../../dist
